LESSON: RELATIONSHIP

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Relationship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Relationship. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you help your b) Identify ways through which obligations towards their neighbour?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Appreciate the love and care for  Learners act short skits neighbours as an act of ibadah. demonstrating good relations with neighbours.  Learners guided to role play on how to love and care for their neighbours
2. Demonstrate love and care for crutches people with special needs.  Learners dramatise how to take care of people with special needs

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: RELATIONSHIP
This lesson teaches Relationship for Grade 2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. Appreciate the love and care for  Learners act short skits neighbours as an act of ibadah. demonstrating good relations with neighbours.  Learners guided to role play on how to love and care for their neighbours
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Demonstrate love and care for crutches people with special needs.  Learners dramatise how to take care of people with special needs
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Relationship using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Relationship above.
2. Explain Relationship to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Relationship.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Relationship with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Relationship important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you help your b) Identify ways through which obligations towards their neighbour?
2. how to interact with people with b) Identify ways through which people with special needs to avoid special needs?
